text.text: Before any booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
Do not provide information, knowledge, procedures, or subjective recommendations/comments not provided by the user or available tools.
Deny requests that are against policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the agent's scope; use the prescribed transfer sequence.
For booking, first obtain the user's user ID.
All flights in a reservation must use the same cabin class.
A reservation may contain at most five passengers.
For each booking passenger, collect first name, last name, and date of birth.
All passengers in a reservation must fly the same flights in the same cabin.
A reservation may use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.
Booking payment methods must already be in the user's profile.
Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.
For flight modification, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; the user must provide the user ID.
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified.
Non-basic-economy reservations may be modified only without changing origin, destination, or trip type.
Before calling the flight-change API, ensure that the flight-change rules apply.
Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
A cabin change must apply across all flights in the reservation; changing one segment's cabin is not possible.
The user may add but may not remove checked bags.
The user cannot add insurance after the initial booking.
Passenger details may be modified, but the number of passengers cannot be modified, including by a human agent.
When flights are changed, use one gift card or credit card already in the user's profile for payment or refund.
For cancellation, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; the user must provide the user ID.
For cancellation, obtain the cancellation reason.
If any portion of a flight has already been flown, do not handle its cancellation and transfer is required.
Only cancel an unflown flight when the stated cancellation-eligibility conditions are met.
Before calling the cancellation API, ensure that cancellation rules are met.
Cancellation refunds go to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.
Do not proactively offer compensation unless the user explicitly asks for it.
Do not compensate a regular member without travel insurance who flies basic economy or economy.
Always confirm the facts before offering compensation.
Only compensate a silver/gold member, a traveler with insurance, or a business-class traveler.
Do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight and delayed-flight circumstances.

norms.text: Before any booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
Do not provide information, knowledge, procedures, or subjective recommendations/comments not provided by the user or available tools.
Deny requests that are against policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the agent's scope; use the prescribed transfer sequence.
For booking, first obtain the user's user ID.
All flights in a reservation must use the same cabin class.
A reservation may contain at most five passengers.
For each booking passenger, collect first name, last name, and date of birth.
All passengers in a reservation must fly the same flights in the same cabin.
A reservation may use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards.
Booking payment methods must already be in the user's profile.
Do not add checked bags that the user does not need.
For flight modification, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; the user must provide the user ID.
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified.
Non-basic-economy reservations may be modified only without changing origin, destination, or trip type.
Before calling the flight-change API, ensure that the flight-change rules apply.
Cabin cannot be changed if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
A cabin change must apply across all flights in the reservation; changing one segment's cabin is not possible.
The user may add but may not remove checked bags.
The user cannot add insurance after the initial booking.
Passenger details may be modified, but the number of passengers cannot be modified, including by a human agent.
When flights are changed, use one gift card or credit card already in the user's profile for payment or refund.
For cancellation, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; the user must provide the user ID.
For cancellation, obtain the cancellation reason.
If any portion of a flight has already been flown, do not handle its cancellation and transfer is required.
Only cancel an unflown flight when the stated cancellation-eligibility conditions are met.
Before calling the cancellation API, ensure that cancellation rules are met.
Cancellation refunds go to the original payment methods within five to seven business days.
Do not proactively offer compensation unless the user explicitly asks for it.
Do not compensate a regular member without travel insurance who flies basic economy or economy.
Always confirm the facts before offering compensation.
Only compensate a silver/gold member, a traveler with insurance, or a business-class traveler.
Do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight and delayed-flight circumstances.

final_results.notes: Recommended, rather than required, workflows were present for asking booking trip details and travel-insurance interest, so they were not recorded as norms. Message/tool-call mechanics, including the one-tool-call instruction and the prohibition on simultaneous user response and tool call, were excluded as harness-format rules. The agent made four tool calls in one assistant block, but that behavior is therefore not recorded as a norm event.

final_results.notes: Formatting-only requirements for chat responses and code blocks were excluded under the harness-format rule. The modality- and programming-language-discussion restrictions and their termination formats were treated as phase/harness mechanics rather than ledger norms. The Code Reviewer's proposals for random review, known/unknown marking, and exit confirmation were recommendations, not independently sourced mandatory norms. The final manual contains unsupported project-specific factual claims such as a repository URL and MIT licensing, but these are not rules governing agent conduct and therefore are not authored rules.

If a SIM is locked because of incorrect PIN or PUK entries, escalate for SIM-security assistance. [T0B0]
After resetting APN settings, instruct the user to reboot the device so the changes apply. [T0B0]

Chief Executive Officer is responsible for high-level decisions on user demands, policy, strategy, leadership, management, execution, and organizational communication. [T0B2]
Chief Technology Officer makes high-level technology-infrastructure decisions aligned with organizational goals and works with IT staff on operations. [T0B30]
Programmer is responsible for creating computer software or applications using programming languages. [T0B59]
Code Reviewer is responsible for assessing source code, troubleshooting and fixing bugs, increasing quality and robustness, and offering improvement proposals. [T0B71]
Counselor is responsible for asking what users and customers think and providing valuable suggestions. [T0B24]
During demand analysis, discuss only the product modality and nothing else. [T0B1]

Modify the code according to review comments and output complete code with all bugs fixed. [T0B77]

text.text: Before any booking-database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
Do not provide information or procedures unavailable from the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments.
Deny user requests that conflict with policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request is outside the agent's scope; perform the transfer tool call before sending the prescribed transfer notice.
For a booking, first obtain the user's user ID.
A booking reservation must use one cabin class across all flights, have at most five passengers, and have all passengers on the same flights in that cabin.
For a booking, collect each passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth.
Booking payments may use at most one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards; payment methods must already be in the user's profile.
Do not refund the remaining balance of a travel certificate.
Do not add checked bags the user does not need.
For a flight modification, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID; when the user does not know the reservation ID, help locate it with available tools.
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified; other flight changes must preserve origin, destination, and trip type.
Before calling the modification API for a flight change, verify that the flight-change rules apply.
A cabin change is barred if any flight has been flown; otherwise it must apply to all flight segments and retain one cabin class across the reservation.
For a cabin change, collect payment for an increase and refund a decrease in price.
Checked bags may be added but not removed, and insurance may not be added after the initial booking.
Passengers may be modified but their number cannot be changed, including by a human agent.
When flights are changed, the user must provide one gift card or credit card already in the user's profile as the payment or refund method.
For cancellation, obtain the user's user ID, reservation ID, and cancellation reason; transfer if any portion has been flown.
Cancel only when an allowed cancellation condition applies, and verify cancellation rules before calling the API.
Do not proactively offer compensation; verify facts before offering it; offer compensation only to an eligible member, insured traveler, or business traveler.
Do not compensate an uninsured regular member flying basic economy or economy, and do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight or delayed-flight cases.

For qualifying cancelled-flight complaints, compensation is a $100-per-passenger certificate after fact confirmation; for qualifying delayed-flight change-or-cancel complaints, it is a $50-per-passenger certificate after fact confirmation and the change or cancellation.

Tool-call/message-format mechanics were excluded as harness-format rules. The booking baggage-allowance schedule and the cancellation refund timing were treated as domain information rather than independently phrased required procedures.

text.text: Act only within the retail-agent assistance scope specified by the policy.
Authenticate the user at the beginning by locating their user ID through email or through name plus zip code, even if they provide an ID.
Help only one user per conversation and deny tasks concerning another user.
Before every database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation to proceed.
Do not make up information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments.
Deny user requests that are against policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request is outside the available scope, using the prescribed transfer sequence and message.
Take order actions only on pending or delivered orders.
Call exchange or modify-order tools no more than once per order, after collecting all items to be changed into one list.
Cancel an order only when it is pending, and check its status before cancellation.
For cancellation, obtain confirmation of the order ID and an acceptable reason: no longer needed or ordered by mistake.
Modify an order only when it is pending, and check its status before modifying it.
For a pending order, modify only its shipping address, payment method, or product item options.
A payment modification must use one payment method different from the original one; a gift card must cover the total amount.

For pending-order item modifications, change each item only to an available variant of the same product with different options, obtain a payment method for any price difference, and ensure a gift card covers that difference.
Return an order only when it is delivered, and check its status before taking the return action.
For a return, obtain confirmation of the order ID and returned-item list, and obtain a refund method that is either the original payment method or an existing gift card.
Exchange an order only when it is delivered, check its status first, and remind the customer to confirm that all exchange items have been provided.
For an exchange, use an available variant of the same product with different options and obtain a payment method for any price difference; a gift card must cover that difference.

text.text: List update details and obtain explicit user confirmation before updating a booking. [T0B0]
Obtain the user's ID before booking a flight. [T0B0]
Use the same cabin class for every flight in a reservation. [T0B0]

A reservation may have no more than five passengers, and the agent must collect each passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth; all passengers must take the same flights in the same cabin. [T0B0]
Booking payments are limited to one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards, and payment methods must already be in the user's profile. [T0B0]
Do not add checked bags the user does not need. [T0B0]
Before modifying a flight, obtain the user's ID and reservation ID; the user must provide the user ID. [T0B0]
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified. [T0B0]
Flight modifications may not change origin, destination, or trip type, and the agent must ensure the modification rules apply before calling the API. [T0B0]
A cabin change is prohibited if any flight has been flown; otherwise it must cover all flight segments, preserve a common cabin, and require payment of a higher price difference. [T0B0]
Checked bags may be added but not removed. [T0B0]
Passengers may be modified, but the number of passengers cannot be modified. [T0B0]
When flights are changed, use a single gift card or credit card already in the user's profile for payment or refund. [T0B0]
Before cancelling, obtain the user's ID, reservation ID, and cancellation reason. [T0B0]
If any portion of a flight has been flown, the agent cannot cancel it and a transfer is needed. [T0B0]
Only cancel an unflown reservation when an enumerated cancellation condition applies, and ensure the cancellation rules apply before calling the API. [T0B0]
Do not proactively offer compensation unless the user explicitly asks for it. [T0B0]
Do not compensate a regular member without travel insurance who flies basic economy or economy. [T0B0]
Always confirm the facts before offering compensation. [T0B0]
Only compensate users who are silver or gold members, have travel insurance, or fly business. [T0B0]
Do not offer compensation for reasons other than cancelled-flight complaints or qualifying delayed-flight change-or-cancel complaints. [T0B0]
A flight that is delayed, on time, or flying cannot be booked. [T0B0]
The unused balance of a travel certificate is not refundable. [T0B0]
Apply the stated membership- and cabin-based checked-bag allowances, with each extra bag costing $50. [T0B0]

Take order actions only on pending or delivered orders. [T0B0]
For an exchange or order modification, call the relevant tool only once per order and collect all items to be changed before that call. [T0B0]

A pending-order cancellation requires checking that the order is pending, confirming the order ID and a permitted reason, and accepting only “no longer needed” or “ordered by mistake” as cancellation reasons. [T0B0]
A pending-order modification requires checking that the order is pending before acting, and may modify only the shipping address, payment method, or product-item options. [T0B0]
A payment-method modification must use one payment method different from the original; a selected gift card must have enough balance to cover the order total. [T0B0]

For a pending-order item modification, confirm all details and remind the customer to confirm they have supplied every item they want changed, because the action may be performed only once per order. [T0B0]
A modified item must be an available item of the same product type with different product options; product types cannot be changed. [T0B0]
For an item modification, the user must provide a payment method for any price difference; a provided gift card must have sufficient balance for that difference. [T0B0]
A return requires checking that the order is delivered, confirmation of the order ID and returned-item list, and a refund method that is either the original method or an existing gift card. [T0B0]
An exchange requires checking that the order is delivered and reminding the customer to confirm that all items for exchange have been provided. [T0B0]

For an exchange, each replacement must be an available item of the same product type with different options; the user must provide a payment method for any price difference, and a provided gift card must have sufficient balance. [T0B0]

norms.text: Obtain explicit user confirmation before any booking-database update. [T0B0]
Do not provide information, knowledge, procedures, or subjective comments not provided by the user or available tools. [T0B0]
Deny user requests that are against policy. [T0B0]
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the agent's scope, using the prescribed transfer procedure. [T0B0]
For booking, first obtain the user's user ID. [T0B0]
A booking reservation must use the same cabin class across all flights. [T0B0]
A booking reservation may have at most five passengers. [T0B0]
Collect each booking passenger's first name, last name, and date of birth. [T0B0]
All passengers in a booking must fly the same flights in the same cabin. [T0B0]
A booking may use at most one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards. [T0B0]
Booking payment methods must already be in the user's profile. [T0B0]
Do not add checked bags the user does not need. [T0B0]
For flight modification, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID first. [T0B0]
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified. [T0B0]
Other flight modifications must not change the origin, destination, or trip type. [T0B0]
Before calling the modification API, ensure that the flight-change rules apply. [T0B0]
Do not change cabin if any flight in the reservation has already been flown. [T0B0]
A cabin change must apply the same cabin class across all flights in the reservation. [T0B0]
For a higher-priced cabin change, require the user to pay the difference. [T0B0]
Users may add but may not remove checked bags. [T0B0]
Users cannot add travel insurance after initial booking. [T0B0]
Passenger modifications cannot change the number of passengers. [T0B0]
When flights change, use a single gift card or credit card already in the user's profile for payment or refund. [T0B0]
For cancellation, obtain the user's user ID and reservation ID first. [T0B0]
Obtain the user's reason for cancellation. [T0B0]
If any portion of a flight has been flown, do not handle its cancellation and transfer the user. [T0B0]
Cancel a flight only when a listed cancellation-eligibility condition is met. [T0B0]
Before calling the cancellation API, ensure that cancellation rules are met. [T0B0]
Do not proactively offer compensation unless the user explicitly asks for it. [T0B0]
Do not compensate a regular member without travel insurance who flies basic economy or economy. [T0B0]
Confirm the facts before offering compensation. [T0B0]
Only compensate users who are silver or gold members, have travel insurance, or fly business. [T0B0]
For a complaint about a cancelled reservation flight, compensation may only be a $100-per-passenger certificate offered after confirming facts. [T0B0]
For a delayed-flight complaint where the user wants to change or cancel, compensation may only be a $50-per-passenger certificate offered after confirming facts and changing or cancelling. [T0B0]
Do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight and delayed-flight circumstances. [T0B0]

For a plan change, identify the line, gather plans, have the user select one, calculate and confirm the new price, then apply the plan to the line associated with the supplied phone number.[T0B0]

First identify the customer before providing technical support.[T0B0]
Try all possible ways to resolve a technical-support issue before transferring the user to a human agent.[T0B0]

text.text: Authenticate the user at the beginning by locating their user ID via email or name plus ZIP, even if they provide a user ID.
Help only one user per conversation and deny requests concerning any other user.
Before any database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation of yes.
Do not make up information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments.
Deny user requests that are against policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within scope; call the transfer tool first and then send the required transfer notice.
Only take order actions on pending or delivered orders.
Before returning a delivered order, check that the order status is delivered.
For a delivered-order return, obtain confirmation of the order ID and returned-item list and obtain a payment method for the refund.
A return refund may go only to the original payment method or an existing gift card.
Before modifying a pending order, check that its status is pending.
For a pending order, modifications are limited to shipping address, payment method, or product item options.
Exchange or modify order tools may be called only once per order, and all item changes must be collected before the tool call.
A pending-order item may be changed only to an available item of the same product with different options, and a payment method is required for the price difference.
Before modifying order items, remind the customer to confirm that they have provided all items they want to modify.
After the pending-order item-modification action, do not modify or cancel that order again.

text.text: Handle only technical support, overdue bill payment, line suspension, and plan-option matters.[T0B0]
Do not provide information, knowledge, or procedures absent from the user’s information or available tools.[T0B0]
Do not give subjective recommendations or comments.[T0B0]
Deny requests that are against policy.[T0B0]
Transfer to a human if and only if the request cannot be handled within the agent’s scope; first call the transfer tool and then send the prescribed transfer message.[T0B0]
Try the best available resolution before transferring the user.[T0B0]
For name-based customer lookup, require date of birth for verification.[T0B0]

For an overdue-bill payment, verify overdue status and amount, send a payment request, instruct the user to check it, make payment after acceptance, and verify PAID status before saying the bill is paid.[T0B0]
Allow only one bill in AWAITING PAYMENT status, and always verify a bill is overdue before sending a payment request.[T0B0]
Lift a suspended line only after all overdue bills are paid; never lift it when its contract end date has passed; instruct the user to reboot after resumption.[T0B0]
For data refueling, ask the requested amount, confirm price, apply it to the provided phone-number line, and do not refuel more than 2GB.[T0B0]
For a plan change, identify the line, gather available plans, have the user select one, calculate and confirm price, then apply it to the provided phone-number line.[T0B0]
When a user is outside the home network, check whether the line is roaming enabled and enable it at no cost if it is not.[T0B0]
Identify the customer before providing technical support.[T0B0]
For technical support, try all possible ways to resolve the issue before transferring to a human agent.[T0B0]
If Airplane Mode is on during service troubleshooting, guide the user to turn it off with toggle_airplane_mode.[T0B0]
For SIM troubleshooting, check SIM status; if missing, guide reseating it, and if locked, escalate for SIM-security assistance.[T0B0]
If APN settings are incorrect or the MMS MMSC URL is missing, guide resetting APN settings and instruct the user to reboot afterward.[T0B0]
If a suspension cannot be lifted under general policy, escalate to technical support; if it can be lifted, verify service restoration.[T0B0]
If mobile data is disabled, guide the user to turn it on with toggle_data.[T0B0]
For a roaming user whose mobile data is not working, guide enabling device data roaming and check that the provided-number line is roaming enabled.[T0B0]
If Data Saver is on, guide the user to turn it off.[T0B0]
If a connected VPN has poor performance, guide the user to disconnect it.[T0B0]
If network mode is 2G or 3G, guide setting the preference to 4g_5g_preferred.[T0B0]
For MMS troubleshooting, ensure the user can make calls and that mobile data works for other apps before proceeding with MMS-specific troubleshooting.[T0B0]
If MMS network status is 2G, guide changing to a mode including 3G, 4G, or 5G.[T0B0]
If Wi-Fi Calling is on while troubleshooting MMS, guide turning it off.[T0B0]
If the messaging app lacks storage or SMS permission, guide granting both permissions.[T0B0]

text.text: Authenticate the user at the beginning by locating the user ID via email or via name plus zip code, even if the user supplies an ID. [T0B0]
Help only one user per conversation and deny requests concerning another user. [T0B0]
Before any database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation. [T0B0]
Do not invent information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments. [T0B0]
Deny user requests that are against policy. [T0B0]
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within scope; first call the transfer tool and then send the required transfer message. [T0B0]
Only take retail actions on pending or delivered orders. [T0B0]
Cancel an order only when it is pending, and check its status before cancelling it. [T0B0]
For cancellation, obtain confirmation of the order ID and an allowed reason: "no longer needed" or "ordered by mistake." [T0B0]
Modify an order only when it is pending, and check its status before modifying it. [T0B0]
For a pending order, modify only shipping address, payment method, or product-item options. [T0B0]
A payment-method modification must use one payment method different from the original method. [T0B0]
When modifying payment to a gift card, ensure the gift card has enough balance for the order total. [T0B0]
Call an exchange or modify-order tool no more than once per order, after collecting all items to be changed. [T0B0]
Before modifying items, confirm all modification details are correct and remind the customer to provide every item they want modified. [T0B0]
Modify a pending-order item only to an available item of the same product with different options. [T0B0]
For item modification, obtain a payment method for any price difference, and ensure a supplied gift card covers that difference. [T0B0]
Return an order only when it is delivered, and check its status before returning it. [T0B0]
For a return, obtain confirmation of the order ID and the list of items to return. [T0B0]
For a return, obtain a payment method for the refund. [T0B0]
Send a return refund only to the original payment method or an existing gift card. [T0B0]
Exchange an order only when it is delivered, check its status first, and remind the customer to provide every item to exchange. [T0B0]
Exchange a delivered-order item only for an available item of the same product with different options. [T0B0]
For an exchange, obtain a payment method for any price difference, and ensure a supplied gift card covers that difference. [T0B0]

norms.text: Authenticate the user at the beginning by locating the user ID via email or via name plus zip code, even if the user supplies an ID. [T0B0]
Help only one user per conversation and deny requests concerning another user. [T0B0]
Before any database update, list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation. [T0B0]
Do not invent information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or tools, and do not give subjective recommendations or comments. [T0B0]
Deny user requests that are against policy. [T0B0]
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within scope; first call the transfer tool and then send the required transfer message. [T0B0]
Only take retail actions on pending or delivered orders. [T0B0]
Cancel an order only when it is pending, and check its status before cancelling it. [T0B0]
For cancellation, obtain confirmation of the order ID and an allowed reason: "no longer needed" or "ordered by mistake." [T0B0]
Modify an order only when it is pending, and check its status before modifying it. [T0B0]
For a pending order, modify only shipping address, payment method, or product-item options. [T0B0]
A payment-method modification must use one payment method different from the original method. [T0B0]
When modifying payment to a gift card, ensure the gift card has enough balance for the order total. [T0B0]
Call an exchange or modify-order tool no more than once per order, after collecting all items to be changed. [T0B0]
Before modifying items, confirm all modification details are correct and remind the customer to provide every item they want modified. [T0B0]
Modify a pending-order item only to an available item of the same product with different options. [T0B0]
For item modification, obtain a payment method for any price difference, and ensure a supplied gift card covers that difference. [T0B0]
Return an order only when it is delivered, and check its status before returning it. [T0B0]
For a return, obtain confirmation of the order ID and the list of items to return. [T0B0]
For a return, obtain a payment method for the refund. [T0B0]
Send a return refund only to the original payment method or an existing gift card. [T0B0]
Exchange an order only when it is delivered, check its status first, and remind the customer to provide every item to exchange. [T0B0]
Exchange a delivered-order item only for an available item of the same product with different options. [T0B0]
For an exchange, obtain a payment method for any price difference, and ensure a supplied gift card covers that difference. [T0B0]

final_results.notes: The system's one-tool-call and no-simultaneous-response instructions are harness/tool-call mechanics and were excluded. Descriptions of post-action database statuses, refunds, and emails were treated as operational outcomes rather than independently required norms. No recommended workflow was present.

The agent says it needs to verify the user's identity before proceeding. [T0B3:<RANGE>To get started, I need to verify your identity.</RANGE>]
The agent states the alternate name-and-zip identity lookup method. [T0B5:<RANGE>I can also look up your account using your first name, last name, and zip code.</RANGE>]
The agent performs the prescribed name-and-zip user-ID lookup. [T0B7:<RANGE>find_user_id_by_name_zip(first_name=Aarav, last_name=Anderson, zip=19031)</RANGE>]
The policy limits assistance to one user and requires denial of other-user requests. [T0B0]
The policy requires action details and explicit confirmation before database updates. [T0B0]

The agent lists both exchange details and asks for confirmation before processing. [T0B19:<RANGE>Here’s a summary of your exchange request for order #W4316152:</RANGE>] [T0B19:<RANGE>Please confirm that you want to proceed with this exchange</RANGE>]
The policy prohibits invented information and procedures not supplied by the user or tools. [T0B0]

The agent asserts an unprovided procedure and access channel for adding a payment method through account settings on a website or app. [T0B29:<RANGE>If you need to add a new payment method, please do so through your account settings on our website or app</RANGE>]
The policy requires denial of policy-violating requests. [T0B0]
The policy specifies when and how to transfer the user to a human agent. [T0B0]
The policy limits actions to pending or delivered orders. [T0B0]
The agent initiates an exchange on the order previously retrieved as delivered. [T0B21:<RANGE>exchange_delivered_order_items(order_id=#W4316152</RANGE>] [T0B14:<RANGE>"status": "delivered"</RANGE>]
The policy limits cancellation to pending orders and requires a status check. [T0B0]
The policy requires an order-ID confirmation and one of two permitted cancellation reasons. [T0B0]
The policy limits order modifications to pending orders and requires a status check. [T0B0]
The policy lists the only permitted categories of pending-order modifications. [T0B0]
The policy limits payment modifications to one method different from the original. [T0B0]
The policy requires sufficient gift-card balance when changing payment to a gift card. [T0B0]
The policy permits exchange or modification tools only once per order and only after all changed items are collected. [T0B0]

The agent makes one exchange-tool call containing both original item IDs and both requested replacement item IDs. [T0B21:<RANGE>exchange_delivered_order_items(order_id=#W4316152, item_ids=['7292993796', '7292993796'], new_item_ids=['3761330360', '9647374798'], payment_method_id=gift_card_7245904)</RANGE>]
The policy requires confirmation of all item-modification details and a reminder to provide all modified items. [T0B0]
The policy restricts item modifications to available same-product variants with different options. [T0B0]
The policy requires a payment method for item-modification price differences and sufficient supplied gift-card balance. [T0B0]
The policy limits returns to delivered orders and requires a status check. [T0B0]
The policy requires return confirmation of the order ID and returned-item list. [T0B0]
The policy requires a payment method for a return refund. [T0B0]
The policy limits return refunds to the original payment method or an existing gift card. [T0B0]
The policy limits exchanges to delivered orders, requires checking status, and requires reminding the customer to provide all exchange items. [T0B0]
The agent retrieves the specified order before pursuing the exchange. [T0B13:<RANGE>get_order_details(order_id=#W4316152)</RANGE>]

The agent asks the customer to confirm that all items they wish to exchange have been included. [T0B19:<RANGE>please confirm that you have included all items you wish to exchange from this order</RANGE>]
The policy restricts exchanges to available variants of the same product with different options. [T0B0]
The agent retrieves the tea-kettle product's variants and availability before selecting replacements. [T0B15:<RANGE>get_product_details(product_id=9832717871)</RANGE>]

The agent states that each kettle may be exchanged for an available variant of the same product type. [T0B17:<RANGE>You can exchange each for another available tea kettle variant of the same product type.</RANGE>]

The exchange call uses two replacement tea-kettle variant IDs collected from the available product variants. [T0B21:<RANGE>new_item_ids=['3761330360', '9647374798']</RANGE>] [T0B16:<RANGE>"3761330360": {"item_id": "3761330360"</RANGE>] [T0B16:<RANGE>"9647374798": {"item_id": "9647374798"</RANGE>]
The policy requires a payment method for an exchange price difference and sufficient balance when that method is a gift card. [T0B0]

The agent submits the exchange using the gift card despite the exchange requiring an additional payment that the card cannot cover. [T0B21:<RANGE>payment_method_id=gift_card_7245904</RANGE>] [T0B22:<RANGE>Error: Insufficient gift card balance to pay for the price difference</RANGE>]
The environment reports that the gift card lacks enough balance for the exchange price difference. [T0B22:<RANGE>Error: Insufficient gift card balance to pay for the price difference</RANGE>]
The agent states that the gift card cannot cover the exchange price difference. [T0B23:<RANGE>Your gift card does not have enough balance to cover the price difference for this exchange.</RANGE>]

text.text: Before updating the booking database, list action details and obtain explicit user confirmation.
Do not provide information, knowledge, procedures, or subjective comments not provided by the user or available tools.
Deny user requests that are against policy.
Transfer to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the agent's scope, using the required transfer procedure.
Obtain the user's ID before booking a flight.
Use the same cabin class across every flight in a reservation.
A reservation may contain at most five passengers.
Collect first name, last name, and date of birth for every booking passenger.
All passengers in a reservation must fly the same flights in the same cabin.
A reservation may use at most one travel certificate, one credit card, and three gift cards.
Use only payment methods already in the user's profile.
Do not add checked bags the user does not need.
Before modifying a flight reservation, obtain the user ID and reservation ID.
Basic-economy flights cannot be modified.
Flight modifications must not change the origin, destination, or trip type.
Verify flight-change rules before calling the modification API.
Do not change cabin if any flight in the reservation has already been flown.
A cabin change must apply to all flights in the reservation and preserve a common cabin class.
For a cabin change, collect any higher fare difference and refund any lower fare difference.
Checked bags may be added but not removed.
Do not add insurance after the initial booking.
Passengers may be modified, but the number of passengers may not be modified.
When flights are changed, use a single gift card or credit card already in the user's profile for payment or refund.
Before cancelling, obtain the user ID and reservation ID.
Obtain the reason for cancellation before cancelling.
If any portion of a flight has already been flown, transfer the cancellation request to a human agent.
Cancel a flight only when it was booked within 24 hours, cancelled by the airline, is business class, or has insurance covering the stated reason.
Verify cancellation eligibility rules before calling the cancellation API.
Do not proactively offer compensation unless the user explicitly asks for it.
Do not compensate a regular member without travel insurance who flies basic economy or economy.
Always confirm the facts before offering compensation.
Compensate only a silver or gold member, a user with travel insurance, or a business-class flyer.
For a complaint about a cancelled flight, a certificate may be offered only after facts are confirmed, at $100 per passenger.

For a complaint about a delayed flight where the user wants to change or cancel, a certificate may be offered only after facts are confirmed and the reservation is changed or cancelled, at $50 per passenger.
Do not offer compensation for reasons other than the listed cancelled-flight and delayed-flight circumstances.
